title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Information Systems (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Information Systems (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is used for securely browsing the web?
questions.explanation: HTTPS is the secure version of HTTP, using encryption (SSL/TLS) for secure communication between browsers and servers to protect sensitive information.

questions.questionText: In OOSAD, what does the term 'polymorphism' refer to?
options: The ability of different objects to respond uniquely to the same message
The use of the same name for different methods
The ability to inherit attributes and methods from a parent class
The process of hiding the internal state of an object
questions.explanation: Polymorphism allows different objects to respond to the same method call in different ways, enabling objects of different classes to be treated as objects of a common superclass.

questions.questionText: Which of the following approaches to AI focuses on creating machines that can perform tasks in a way that is indistinguishable from how a human would perform them?
questions.explanation: Acting humanly refers to AI systems designed to mimic human behavior.

questions.questionText: The normalization was first proposed by ______________.
questions.explanation: Codd proposed the concept of normalization in database design.

questions.questionText: Which phase of the system development life cycle (SDLC) involves identifying security requirements, designing security controls, and implementing security measures to protect the system from potential threats?
questions.explanation: The Design phase focuses on security requirements and controls.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the activation function in a neural network?
options: To control the learning rate of the model
To introduce non-linearity into the model
To reduce overfitting in the model
To increase the number of neurons in the network
questions.explanation: Activation functions introduce non-linearity, allowing the network to learn complex patterns.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a physical security control used to protect a data center?
questions.explanation: Biometric access control systems are physical security measures for data centers.

questions.questionText: What is artificial intelligence?
options: type of natural intelligence found in animals
Intelligence that is artificially enhanced in humans
questions.explanation: Artificial intelligence refers to the capability of machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.

questions.questionText: Given the following, what value does the left margin have? margin:10px 5px 20px 15px;
questions.explanation: In CSS margin shorthand, the order is top, right, bottom, left (clockwise from top). So the left margin value is 15px.

questions.questionText: A transaction is in __________ state after the final statement has been executed.
questions.explanation: A transaction is considered committed once all operations have been successfully completed.

questions.questionText: Which form of machine learning is most similar to the way humans learn?
questions.explanation: Reinforcement Learning mimics the way humans learn through trial and error.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is used to dynamically assign IP addresses to devices on a network?
questions.explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) is used for dynamic IP address assignment.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is true about abstract classes?
options: An abstract class cannot have any concrete methods.
An abstract class can be instantiated.
An abstract class cannot have any fields or properties.
An abstract class can contain both abstract and concrete methods.
questions.explanation: Abstract classes can have both abstract methods (without implementation) and concrete methods (with implementation).

questions.questionText: What is the primary purpose of the system investigation phase?
options: To identify the problem and evaluate feasibility
questions.explanation: The system investigation phase focuses on identifying problems and assessing feasibility.

questions.questionText: Which AI technique involves mimicking the human brain's structure and functions?
questions.explanation: Neural networks are designed to simulate the way the human brain processes information.

questions.questionText: From the following Web terminologies, choose the best definition for the term ARPA?
questions.explanation: ARPA stands for Advanced Research Projects Agency, known for its role in developing the internet.

questions.questionText: Which of the following software security practices involves identifying and fixing security vulnerabilities in software code?
questions.explanation: Secure coding practices focus on writing code that is free from vulnerabilities.

questions.questionText: What does NLP stand for in the context of AI?
questions.explanation: NLP stands for Natural Language Processing, a field of AI focused on the interaction between computers and human language.

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of a use case diagram?
options: To show the structure of the system
To model the dynamic behavior of the system
To describe the functional requirements of a system
To represent the data flow in the system
questions.explanation: Use case diagrams illustrate the functional requirements and interactions of a system.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental principle of information security?
questions.explanation: The CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability) forms the fundamental principles of information security. Compliance is important but is not considered one of the core principles.

questions.questionText: What is a disjoint less constraint?
options: It requires that an entity belongs to no more than one level entity set.
The same entity may belong to more than one level.
The database must contain an unmatched foreign key value.
An entity can be joined with another entity in the same level entity set.
questions.explanation: A disjoint constraint (not 'disjoint less') ensures that an entity can only belong to one subclass or specialization of a superclass at a time.

questions.questionText: What type of transmission sends data to all devices on a network?
questions.explanation: Broadcast transmission sends data to all devices on a network segment.

questions.questionText: Which header file is required to use the std::vector in C++?
questions.explanation: The std::vector class is defined in the <vector> header file.

questions.questionText: If the closure of an attribute set is the entire relation, then the attribute set is a
questions.explanation: When the closure of an attribute set includes all attributes of the relation, it means the attribute set functionally determines all attributes, making it a super key.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a feature of Object-Oriented Programming?
questions.explanation: Compilation is not a feature of OOP; it is a process of converting code into executable form.

questions.questionText: Polymorphism in OOP allows:
options: The same method to perform differently based on the object that calls it.
The hiding of data from outside the class.
The creation of a blueprint for objects.
The inheritance of properties from one class to another.
questions.explanation: Polymorphism allows methods to be invoked on different objects, producing different results.

questions.questionText: What is a common use of computer vision in AI?
questions.explanation: Computer vision is primarily used for analyzing images and videos.

questions.questionText: Analyze the following markup code, choose the best properly formatted link?
questions.explanation: The correct format for a hyperlink in HTML is Link.

questions.questionText: What type of cable is used in Ethernet networks?
questions.explanation: Twisted Pair cables are commonly used in Ethernet networks.

questions.questionText: What is the primary purpose of a process specification in system design?
options: To define the system's functional requirements
To represent the logic of decision-making
questions.explanation: Process specifications define the functional requirements of a system.

questions.questionText: In which network topology is each computer connected to a central hub?
questions.explanation: In a star topology, all devices are connected to a central hub.

questions.questionText: In which scenario is agile software development preferable, and what are the roles of the system analyst and system designer in this context?
options: When the project requirements are well-defined, stable, and unlikely to change during development.
When the project involves complex and rapidly changing requirements, with a high degree of uncertainty.
When the project has a fixed timeline and budget, and the scope must be strictly adhered to.
When the project is small and simple, with a clear and straightforward set of requirements.
questions.explanation: Agile development is best suited for projects with changing requirements.

questions.questionText: Which statement is best to describe Web Development?
options: It is the process of designing a website or web application
It is the process of creating a website or web application
It is the process of maintaining a website or web application
questions.explanation: Web development encompasses designing, creating, and maintaining web applications.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a common ensemble learning technique?
questions.explanation: Gradient Boosting is a popular ensemble learning technique used in machine learning.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of a decision table in system design?
options: To represent the logic of decision-making
To define the system's physical components
questions.explanation: Decision tables are used to represent complex decision logic in a structured format.

questions.questionText: What is the primary purpose of the system implementation phase?
options: To build and test the new system
questions.explanation: The implementation phase focuses on building and testing the new system.

questions.questionText: Fifth Normal form is concerned with
questions.explanation: Fifth Normal Form (5NF), also known as Project-Join Normal Form (PJNF), addresses join dependencies that cannot be implied by candidate keys.

questions.questionText: What is the term used to define a function within a class in C++?
questions.explanation: A function defined within a class is called a member function.

questions.questionText: Which of the following security techniques is used to verify the integrity of data transmitted over a network?
questions.explanation: Hashing is used to verify data integrity by producing a unique hash value for the data.

questions.questionText: During the system implementation phase, the information system expert's primary responsibility is to:
options: Ensure the availability of necessary hardware and infrastructure for the new system.
Coordinate the migration of data from the legacy system to the new system.
Define the acceptance criteria and oversee the user acceptance testing process.
Establish a robust change management strategy and communicate it effectively.
questions.explanation: The expert is responsible for defining acceptance criteria and overseeing testing.

questions.questionText: From the given alternative, which one of the following is correct?
options: HTML is used for exchanging data, XML is not.
XML is used for exchanging data, HTML is not.
HTML can have user-defined tags, XML cannot.
questions.explanation: XML is designed for data exchange and storage with a focus on data structure, while HTML is primarily for displaying content. XML allows user-defined tags while HTML has predefined tags.

questions.questionText: What is the term used when a class is derived from more than one base class?
questions.explanation: Multiple inheritance occurs when a class inherits from more than one base class.

questions.questionText: Which protocol uses port 443 by default?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses port 443 for secure communication over the web.

questions.questionText: Which of the following keywords is used to create an object in most OOP languages?
questions.explanation: The 'new' keyword is commonly used to instantiate objects in many OOP languages.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a key aspect of information security policies and procedures?
options: Implementing biometric authentication for all users
questions.explanation: Training employees is crucial for maintaining security awareness and compliance.

questions.questionText: Which of the following cannot be done with JavaScript?
options: Sending a form's contents by email
Storing the form's contents to a database file on the server
questions.explanation: JavaScript alone cannot directly store data on a server database; it requires server-side technologies like PHP, Node.js, or other backend systems to communicate with databases.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the loss function in a machine learning model?
options: To measure the performance of the model
To control the learning rate of the model
To increase the complexity of the model
questions.explanation: The loss function quantifies how well the model's predictions match the actual outcomes.

questions.questionText: What is the function of a router in a network?
options: To forward packets between different networks
To connect devices within the same network
questions.explanation: Routers are responsible for directing data packets between different networks.

questions.questionText: What is the main difference between classification and regression in machine learning?
options: Classification predicts discrete labels, while regression predicts continuous values
Classification is unsupervised, while regression is supervised
Classification uses neural networks, while regression uses decision trees
Regression predicts discrete labels, while classification predicts continuous values
questions.explanation: Classification deals with categorical outcomes, while regression deals with numerical outcomes.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a common system design principle?
questions.explanation: Inheritance is a feature of OOP, not a design principle.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is used to retrieve email from a mail server?
questions.explanation: POP3 (Post Office Protocol) is used to retrieve emails from a server.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is used to transfer web pages on the internet?
questions.explanation: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the foundation of data communication on the web.

questions.questionText: What is a constructor in C++?
questions.explanation: A constructor is a special member function that initializes objects of a class.

questions.questionText: As an information system expert, what is your primary role in addressing security concerns during the software development process?
options: Ensuring that the development team follows secure coding practices and implements appropriate security controls.
Conducting regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities
Providing security awareness training to the development team and end-users.
Monitoring the software system's performance and optimizing its security features.
questions.explanation: The expert ensures that security practices are integrated into the development process.

questions.questionText: Which programming language is most commonly associated with AI development?
questions.explanation: Python is widely used in AI development due to its simplicity and extensive libraries.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of a learning agent?
options: It can select actions based on its current precept
It can plan its actions based on a set of goals
It can consider all possible actions and select the one that maximizes its expected utility
It can improve its performance over time by learning from its past experiences
questions.explanation: Learning agents adapt and improve their performance based on experience.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct way to declare an integer variable in C++?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for declaring an integer variable in C++ is 'int number;'.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a relationship in UML?
questions.explanation: Association represents a relationship between classes in UML.

questions.questionText: Precedence graphs help to find a
questions.explanation: Precedence graphs (also called serializability graphs or conflict graphs) are used to determine if a schedule is conflict serializable by detecting cycles in the graph.

questions.questionText: What is the main goal of machine learning?
options: To write code that can solve any problem
To enable machines to learn from data and improve over time
To create machines that are indistinguishable from humans
To develop new hardware for faster computations
questions.explanation: The primary goal of machine learning is to allow machines to learn from data.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of using encapsulation in OOSAD?
options: It makes the system more scalable
It hides the internal implementation details of an object
questions.explanation: Encapsulation protects the internal state of an object from outside interference.

questions.questionText: In OOP, which feature allows a subclass to inherit the properties and methods of a superclass?
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows subclasses to inherit attributes and methods from their parent classes.

questions.questionText: How do you declare an array of 10 integers in C++?
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for declaring an array of integers in C++ is 'int array[10];'.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is used to submit data to be processed to a specified resource?
questions.explanation: The POST method is used to send data to a server for processing, typically used for form submissions and creating new resources on the server.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of using Machine Learning algorithms over rule-based systems?
options: They are more flexible and adaptable than rule-based algorithms
ML algorithms require huge amounts of data
ML algorithms require more manual intervention than rule-based algorithms
questions.explanation: Machine Learning algorithms can adapt to new data without needing explicit rules.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a common security measure to protect web applications from Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks?
questions.explanation: Input validation and output encoding are essential security measures to prevent XSS attacks by ensuring that user-supplied content is properly sanitized before being displayed.

questions.questionText: In the context of PHP admin and MySQL, what are the actions of CRUD?
questions.explanation: CRUD stands for Create, Read, Update, and Delete, which are the basic operations for managing data.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a consequence of concurrent operations?
questions.explanation: Update anomaly is not a direct consequence of concurrent operations.

questions.questionText: Which cryptographic technique involves converting plaintext into ciphertext using a secret key for secure communication?
questions.explanation: Symmetric encryption uses a secret key to encrypt and decrypt data.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the ARP protocol?
options: To resolve IP addresses to MAC addresses
questions.explanation: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) resolves IP addresses to MAC addresses.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a common goal of information systems security?
options: Ensuring data confidentiality, integrity, and availability
questions.explanation: The primary goal of information security is to protect data confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

questions.questionText: What are the main responsibilities of a system analyst and a system designer in a software development project?
options: The system analyst is responsible for gathering and documenting requirements, while the system designer is responsible for designing the technical architecture of the system.
The system analyst is responsible for designing the user interface and user experience, while the system designer is responsible for implementing the technical components of the system.
The system analyst is responsible for managing the project schedule and budget, while the system designer is responsible for overseeing the development team.
The system analyst and system designer both have the same responsibilities, as they are interchangeable roles in software development.
questions.explanation: The system analyst focuses on requirements, while the system designer focuses on technical design.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a NoSQL database often used in web development?
questions.explanation: MongoDB is a popular NoSQL database used for web applications.

questions.questionText: Which HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The <a> tag is used to create hyperlinks in HTML.

questions.questionText: What is the primary function of the Domain Name System (DNS)?
options: To map human-friendly domain names to IP addresses
questions.explanation: DNS translates domain names into IP addresses, allowing users to access websites using easy-to-remember names.

questions.questionText: In which network topology is each computer connected to a central hub?
questions.explanation: In a star topology, all devices connect to a central hub or switch.

questions.questionText: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for translating, encrypting, and compressing data?
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer handles data translation, encryption, and compression.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a type of machine learning?
questions.explanation: Instructional learning is not recognized as a type of machine learning.

questions.questionText: What is the primary function of a firewall?
options: To filter incoming and outgoing network traffic
questions.explanation: Firewalls are used to monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic based on security rules.

questions.questionText: What is the correct way to include the standard input-output library in C++?
questions.explanation: The correct way to include the standard input-output library in C++ is '#include <iostream>'.

questions.questionText: Which UML diagram is primarily used to show interactions between objects in terms of messages passed?
questions.explanation: Sequence diagrams illustrate how objects interact in a particular scenario of a use case.

questions.questionText: Which OOP principle helps to eliminate redundant code by allowing code reuse?
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows a class to inherit properties and methods from another class, promoting code reuse.

questions.questionText: Why is PHP most popularly applied in dynamic web development?
options: Allows interaction with visitors in ways HTML alone can't
To design simple email forms or elaborate shopping carts that save past orders and recommend similar products.
Deliver interactive forums and private messaging systems.
questions.explanation: PHP is widely used for creating dynamic web applications because it enables all these capabilities: interactive user experiences, handling forms and shopping systems, and creating communication platforms.

questions.questionText: Which UML diagram is used to represent the dynamic behavior of a single object?
questions.explanation: State diagrams depict the states of an object and the transitions between those states.

questions.questionText: What is the primary purpose of the OSI model?
options: To standardize networking protocols and operations
questions.explanation: The OSI model standardizes the functions of a telecommunication or computing system into abstraction layers.

questions.questionText: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard markup language for creating web pages.

questions.questionText: In which class does the IP address 150.150.150.150 belong?
questions.explanation: The IP address 150.150.150.150 belongs to Class B, which ranges from 128.0.0.0 to 191.255.255.255, determined by the first octet of the IP address.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a key characteristic of a system?
questions.explanation: Entropy is not a characteristic of a system; it refers to disorder or randomness.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a basic requirement of information security that ensures that data is accessible to authorized users when needed?
questions.explanation: Availability ensures that authorized users have access to information and resources when needed.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best describes encapsulation?
options: The ability to create new classes from existing ones.
The practice of hiding the internal details of an object and exposing only what is necessary.
The ability to define a function with the same name in multiple classes.
The concept of defining different forms of a method based on input parameters.
questions.explanation: Encapsulation is a fundamental principle of OOP that restricts access to certain components.

questions.questionText: Manager salary details are hidden from the employee. This is
questions.explanation: External level data hiding restricts access to certain data from users.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of method overloading?
options: Defining two methods with the same name but different parameters in the same class.
Inheriting methods from a base class.
Redefining a method in a derived class.
Hiding the internal state of an object.
questions.explanation: Method overloading allows multiple methods with the same name but different signatures.

questions.questionText: What is the standard failure value in Depth-limited search (DLS)?
options: The node with the highest path cost.
The node with the lowest path cost.
No solution found within the given depth limit.
questions.explanation: In Depth-limited search, if no solution is found within the depth limit, it returns a failure value.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements correctly defines a function in C++ that returns the sum of two integers?
options: int sum(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
int sum(int a, int b) { return a - b; }
int sum(a, b) { return a + b; }
int sum(int a; int b) { return a + b; }
questions.explanation: The correct syntax for defining a function that returns the sum of two integers is shown in the first option.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a property of transactions?
questions.explanation: Concurrency is not a property of transactions; it's a database system capability. The four properties of transactions are often referred to as ACID: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.

questions.questionText: In Object-Oriented Analysis and Design, what does UML stand for?
questions.explanation: UML stands for Unified Modeling Language, used for modeling software systems.

questions.questionText: Which JavaScript function is used to write content into a popup box?
questions.explanation: The alert() function is used to display an alert box with a specified message.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a common unsupervised learning technique?
questions.explanation: K-means clustering is a popular unsupervised learning algorithm used for clustering data.

questions.questionText: Which one of the web technologies is NOT applicable in the design and development of static websites?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is primarily used for dynamic content and interactivity, not for static websites.

questions.questionText: In which type of network does every device connect directly to every other device?
questions.explanation: In a mesh network topology, every device is connected to every other device.
